name: exclusive-arms-lab
description: Hand-authored fixture, wave fourteen lane CN: the exclusive-arm object union fold (batch two, carried-forward item 4). Three pairs, each pinning one outcome the detector must reach - a fold both arms anchor with a required member of their own, a fold only one arm anchors (the other's own distinguisher optional in source), and a pair the detector must not recognize at all because a shared member disagrees in type. The symmetric all-optional pair that TR061 declines is `paramobject-overload-lab`'s own SearchOptions, proven there.
